articles.title: emulators/wine (re)entering OpenBSD ports
articles.summary: In his message to the ports@ mailing list, Thomas Frohwein ( thfr@ ) leads in, In what might the most surprising port proposal of the year, I'm proud to present a new port for wine.

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners update brings improved modding, better HDR, new content and more
articles.summary: CD PROJEKT RED have released another major free update for Cyberpunk 2077 adding new content from the Anime, along with other tech upgrades. Really amazing to see them continue supporting it for this long after release.

articles.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
articles.summary: Anthropic has answered Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with a research preview of Claude Duet. The standalone app runs Claude as a proactive agent that keeps working on tasks while the user is away and asks for approval before taking sensitive steps.

articles.title: Apple says developers are showing ‘incredible’ support for the iPhone Duo
articles.summary: One of the major issues raised by early reviews of the iPhone Duo is limited support by third-party apps. As we noted in our own review , there are three tiers of support currently, the worst of which sees an iPhone app stranded in the center of a mostly black area of the display.

articles.title: Giant iPhone Duo Installations Spotted at Apple Fifth Avenue
articles.summary: Apple is preparing what appear to be giant iPhone Duo displays outside its Fifth Avenue store in New York ahead of the device's launch on Friday, October 23.

articles.title: Android has always been chaotic in the best ways possible
articles.summary: The through-line in every iPhone Duo review yesterday was this: excellent hardware (though a bit too heavy) and a chaotic software experience. When Apple’s foldable launches on Friday, it will remind early adopters of what Android used to feel like whenever a new form factor was introduced: exciting, janky, and slightly aggravating.

articles.title: How Commerce.com and Cloudflare are getting storefronts ready for AI agents
articles.summary: We'll keep investing in WebMCP as the standard evolves, starting with helping agents find a site's tools more easily. Cloudflare and Commerce.com will continue to work together to make shopping with agents fast, reliable and safe for both merchants and shoppers.

articles.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
articles.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.307
articles.summary: Added the claude_code.safety_event OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back.

articles.title: Someone made a Walkman music player for the Galaxy Z Fold 8, and it works with YouTube Music
articles.summary: A Walkman-esque app fits so well on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 because of how wide and short the front display is, just like Sony’s original cassette player.

articles.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV has an exciting new gameplay overview trailer
articles.summary: We've got another close look at Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV ahead of the December release, with an impressive new trailer. This really feels like they've been paying attention, and focusing on what players loved from the original games but modernised.

articles.title: AI cuts coding time, but it's also filling open source's inbox with crap
articles.summary: Almost three-quarters (71 percent) of maintainers reckon GenAI has lowered the barriers to contributing to open source, but just over half (53 percent) disagree that the technology has improved community trust.

articles.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
articles.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon.

articles.title: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter gets teased by Croteam and Devolver Digital
articles.summary: Back for another helping of ridiculous action, Croteam and Devolver Digital have revealed Serious Sam: The Third Encounter. Taking place directly after the classic The Second Encounter, it might be time to go back and refresh your memory.

articles.title: Python 3.15.1, 3.14.9 and 3.13.17 are out
articles.summary: We don’t normally update pip for security releases like Python 3.13 because of backward compatibility concerns, but since 3.13 only just entered security-only mode, doing a special release with installers seemed prudent.

articles.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
articles.summary: Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform. Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.

articles.title: iPhone Duo review roundup: The same problems Android foldables face, but with Apple’s polish
articles.summary: Looking at iPhone Duo reviews from the perspective of someone who’s been using Android foldables as their daily driver for over half a decade at this point, I can’t help but look at Apple’s first attempt and see the foundation it’s building on, but also the places where Apple’s inherent polish comes into play.

articles.title: Epic Games Launcher Preview is slowly becoming actually usable on Linux
articles.summary: Epic Games recently announced a new in-development preview of the Epic Games Launcher, which has Linux support and recent updates have made it not so crap.

articles.title: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait
articles.summary: Inception says Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion language model released so far. The company claims it runs four to eight times faster than GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 and beats both in eight of 12 benchmarks.

articles.title: Announcing rustup 1.29.2
articles.summary: The rustup team is happy to announce the release of rustup version 1.29.2. Rustup is the recommended tool to install Rust , a programming language that empowers everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

articles.title: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
articles.summary: You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview. When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a rotating refresh token and automatically refreshes the token whenever it is needed.

articles.title: iOS Decoded: iOS 27.2 RC – hands-on w/ HomePod Sound Glow, TV profiles, Apple TV Home Theater assets, more [Video]
articles.summary: We also go hands-on with other changes, like the handy new profiles option for the TV app and Suggested Actions for Messages. Further, we take a look at and listen to some of the assets and sounds from Apple TV’s new surround-sound Home Theater functionality.

articles.title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.summary: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations.

articles.title: Mesa Loosens Rules Around AI Agents For Code Comments / Commit Messages
articles.summary: The Mesa 3D graphics driver project has loosened its rules laid out in their AGENTS.md for AI agents to permit AI/LLM assistance in generating code comments and commit/patch messages, as long as a human is ultimately reviewing/editing it in the end.

articles.title: Mesa RADV Change Satisfies More Steam Play Games On Aging AMD GFX8 GPUs
articles.summary: Valve landed a patch in Mesa 27.0 and to be back-ported to current Mesa stable series to satisfy more games running under Steam Play with VKD3D-Proton for working on AMD GFX8 GPUs like Polaris.

articles.title: Ubuntu rolls out php2shell, eMudhra certificate fixes
articles.summary: Ubuntu has released security updates for the php2shell PHP flaw that’s led to websites being taken offline , and a key compromise at the eMudhra certificate authority.

articles.title: Linux 7.4 Kernel Crypto Library Enjoying Optimized AES Implementations On x86 & RISC-V
articles.summary: The latest Linux kernel cryptographic subsystem performance work carried out by Google engineer Eric Biggers is migrating x86/x86_64 and RISC-V optimized implementations of different AES modes into the lib/crypto kernel crypto library to enjoy faster performance there.
